# CopilotForge - Champions

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-port.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Create evidence-led Champion programmes that turn curiosity into capability and capability into contribution, with clear boundaries on what Champions do and do not do.

- **Layer:** adoption
- **Lead role:** Champions Programme Owner
- **Plugin name:** `copilotforge-champions`

| Skill | Status | Lifecycle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`capability-framework`](skills/capability-framework/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Measure | Defines the three Champion capabilities - Chat, productivity and agents - each with an objective, a training option, an evidence option, verification criteria and an outcome, so training is one route rather than the gate, and maps learning sessions open to the wider business onto the journey. Use when setting what a Champion must show, when status needs to mean something, or when experienced colleagues want to skip training. |
| [`champion-advisor`](skills/champion-advisor/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Deliver, Improve | Specifies the Champions advisor, a self-service agent that explains requirements, routes, criteria and next steps from the champion guide - its question set, grounding, what it must refuse such as verification decisions and other people's status, escalation and test questions - before agent design. Use when the programme owner is a bottleneck for questions, or when a Champions advisor is proposed or misbehaving. |
| [`champion-challenges`](skills/champion-challenges/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Deliver, Scale | Designs the Champion Challenge - one practical contribution after the three capabilities are verified, such as an envisioning workshop, team training, a governed business agent, a prompt library, a departmental playbook or support for the Centre of Excellence - with a safety and scope check and assessment on impact, reusability, quality and strategic alignment. Use when Champions are ready to contribute or a challenge idea needs checking. |
| [`champion-community-design`](skills/champion-community-design/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Launch, Scale | Designs the Champion community - the space and its channels, a community manager and moderation, rituals such as community calls, show-and-tell and prompt clinics, peer learning through pairing and learning circles, local spokes, and the route by which good material reaches the scenario catalogue. Use when a new network needs a home, when the Champion channel has gone quiet, or when peer learning depends on one organiser. |
| [`champion-learning`](skills/champion-learning/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Scale, Improve | Designs the learning offer behind the Champion journey - training-route sessions and guided exercises for each capability, exemplars and clinics for the evidence route, Challenge preparation, refreshers when Copilot changes and advanced learning for recognised Champions - shared with the workforce where possible. Use when capabilities need a training route, when sessions feel too basic, or when material is stale. |
| [`champion-metrics`](skills/champion-metrics/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Measure, Improve | Defines the programme-level measure set for Champions - coverage, journey conversion and completion time, contribution, community, boundary drift and adoption context - each with a definition, source, baseline, target, owner, minimum group size and reporting rhythm, plus rules against individual rankings. Use when a sponsor asks what the programme delivers, before a dashboard is built, or when a leader board is proposed. |
| [`champion-programme-design`](skills/champion-programme-design/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Enable | Designs an evidence-led Copilot Champions programme as a progression system - purpose, the six-stage journey, operating boundaries, its place between the adoption programme and the Centre of Excellence, sponsorship, agreed time, community, tracker and self-service guidance. Use when starting or replicating a Champion network, when Champions have become an unpaid help desk, or when status means attendance. |
| [`champion-recruitment`](skills/champion-recruitment/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Enable, Scale | Recruits a representative, motivated Champion cohort - coverage targets by team, site and persona, an open expression of interest on declared interest, skills and availability, manager agreement before acceptance, fair selection without performance data, a waiting list and a welcome. Use when a Champions programme opens, when the network is all enthusiasts from one function, or when Champions joined without manager agreement. |
| [`champions-health-check`](skills/champions-health-check/SKILL.md) | draft | Measure, Scale, Improve | Runs the periodic, usually annual, review of a whole Champions programme - purpose, sponsorship, manager time agreements, boundaries, framework currency against product change, coverage, community and measures - ending in a decision to renew, reshape or close it, with renewed commitments and a refreshed charter. Use when the charter review date arrives, when the sponsor or operating model changes, or when the programme has drifted. |
| [`evidence-assessment`](skills/evidence-assessment/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Assure | Sets up fair, consistent assessment of Champion evidence against each capability's verification criteria and of Champion Challenges, by trained assessors who assess the evidence rather than the person, keep a restricted progress tracker, give useful feedback, handle appeals and never rank anyone. Use when submissions start arriving, when assessors disagree, when progress status is unclear or when a decision is challenged. |
| [`recognition-and-progression`](skills/recognition-and-progression/SKILL.md) | draft | Measure, Scale, Improve | Designs how Champions progress through the six-stage journey to recognised Champion, with recognition linked to demonstrated contribution, access to advanced materials, pilots and specialist pathways, renewal, a regular programme health check and programme-level measures such as milestone conversion. Use when designing Champion recognition, when status has gone stale, or when a sponsor asks whether the programme is healthy. |
